cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Withdraw the Objection
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to drop a complaint, challenge, or special request and accept the official process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Drop the demand to question our delivery driver. The missing-parcel claim goes through this form.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your form requires a photo of the parcel I haven't received.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use a photo of your empty doorstep. That's the delivery location.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you stand in it holding today's newspaper?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, beside the doormat. Put me under 'supporting evidence,' and leave the driver off your witness list.

reason: Remove authority wrappers; preserve A interpreting the form and personally agreeing to the claimant evidence demand to keep the official route.
